description: Figure 4 (right panel) illustrates how MC1 score varies with the number of demonstrations on the BBQ dataset for several methods. The x-axis is labeled “#Demonstrations,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 0 to 1500 with regularly spaced tick labels at 0, 250, 500, 750, 1000, 1250, and 1500. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 40 to 55 with tick labels at 40, 45, 50, and 55. A dark blue solid line with circular markers (labeled “Linear SAE”) starts near 52 at 0 demonstrations, rises to about 54–55 by 100–250 demonstrations, and then stays close to 55 through 1500 demonstrations. A light blue solid line with circular markers (labeled “Sparse Expansion”) stays nearly flat around 48 across the x-axis, starting just under 49 at 0 demonstrations and ending around 48 at 1500 demonstrations. A dashed horizontal pink line (labeled “LLaMA-2-chat-7B”) sits near 43 across all demonstration counts. A dashed horizontal light-blue line (labeled “ICD”) sits near 46 across all demonstration counts.
